svg.title: A closer count separates two curves
svg.desc: Both curves have five solutions modulo five. The parabola has five lifts of each starting pair. The cusp has twenty-five lifts of (0,0) and five lifts of each other pair. Each five-by-five grid shows every possible lift, with solid dots marking the solutions modulo 25.
svg.text: A closer count separates two curves
Each curve starts with five solutions modulo 5. A filled dot still works modulo 25.
Start at the lower left of each block. Right adds 5 to x. Up adds 5 to y.
From (0, 0), the parabola fills one row. At the cusp, all 25 positions work.
